how: Event study per TF; trend gate (SMA200 side) x confluence (none, RSI, divergence) x entry (signal, retest) x session; 1080 cells in dev_cells.csv; day-clustered 95 % CI.
window: DEV 2022-01-01..2024-06-30 BTCUSDT 1m; VALIDATION not read (no DEV survivor); HOLDOUT never loaded

verdict.label: INCONCLUSIVE (underpowered), not FAIL and not PASS. WaveTrend dots with the trend gate, RSI / divergence confluence, retest entry and a session split produced 0 DEV survivors of 24 pooled + 96 session cells (Holm m=24 / 96), so VALIDATION stayed unread and HOLDOUT was never loaded. prereg_gate BLOCKed every TF before the run (BLOCKED.md), so no FAIL can be issued either.

why: Bare dots lose fee-net everywhere: 15m buy -0.131 %, 15m sell -0.202 %, 30m buy -0.103 %, 30m sell -0.254 %, 1h buy -0.342 %, 1h sell -0.295 %; 126 of the 509 cells with n >= 30 have a net CI entirely below zero, none entirely above.

15m sell + RSI >= 60 with-trend: n 257 / 170 days, net +0.008 % [-0.134, +0.149], excess +0.133 % (t 1.91), Holm p 1.0. 1h sell + divergence retest n 19 / 17 days net +1.117 % [+0.007, +2.227]: the only cell with a CI above zero, on 17 days, 120 cells in the family: a lead, not an edge.
Buy + RSI <= 40 + trend gate 15m: n 238 net -0.187 % [-0.303, -0.070], Holm p 0.040 (negative, so no survivor). Sessions: 96 cells, 0 survivors.
Testing the 1h lead needs about 2,100 event-days (n needed 2165): other symbols or a longer history.
